versions.changelog:
- Added reference documentation for SMS error codes (`references/sms-error-codes.md`).
- Improved signature listing: now includes per-carrier registration status for each signature, surfaced in listing tables for user decisions.
- Updated handling rules to avoid dropping signatures based solely on carrier registration status; users can see and select unregistered carrier signs if desired.
- Refined signature and template approval status filtering in interactive parameter confirmation logic.
- Removed obsolete `skill-card.md` reference file.

Initial release of Alibaba Cloud SMS Send Short Message Skill.

- Send SMS (verification codes, notifications, marketing) via Alibaba Cloud SMS through aliyun CLI.
- Supports both single and batch sends, including domestic and international/HK-Macao-Taiwan messages.
- Includes signature and template approval status checks before sending messages.
- Provides interactive confirmation and selection for required parameters (signatures, templates, phone numbers).
- Offers CLI guidance, critical compliance instructions, and error handling best practices.
- Supports querying sending status, statistics, and qualification records.
